.github/workflows/huhu-bot.yml:
name: Build Bot Runner

on:
  workflow_call:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['native/huhubot/**', 'contracts/hap/**', 'scripts/*huhu-bot*', '.github/workflows/huhu-bot.yml']

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-22.04, target: linux-x64, asset: huhu-bot-linux-x64 }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, target: linux-arm64, asset: huhu-bot-linux-arm64 }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, target: darwin-x64, asset: huhu-bot-darwin-x64 }
          - { os: macos-15, target: darwin-arm64, asset: huhu-bot-darwin-arm64 }
          - { os: windows-latest, target: win32-x64, asset: huhu-bot-win32-x64.exe }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.10'
          cache-dependency-path: native/huhubot/go.sum
      - name: Go unit and contract tests
        run: node scripts/build-huhu-bot.mjs --test
      - name: Locked static build and manifest
        run: node scripts/build-huhu-bot.mjs --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Native SQLite persistence, EOF and shutdown smoke
        run: node scripts/verify-huhu-bot.mjs native/huhubot/dist/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: huhu-bot-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: native/huhubot/dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
.github/workflows/lint.yml:
name: Node.js build

on:
    workflow_dispatch:
    workflow_call:
    push:
        branches: ["**"]
    pull_request:
        branches: ["**"]

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        env:
            GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: "1"
            GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
            GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && 'true' || 'false' }}

        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                include:
                    - { os: ubuntu-latest, node-version: 22.x }
                    - { os: ubuntu-latest, node-version: 24.x }
                    - { os: windows-latest, node-version: 24.x }

        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v5
              with:
                  ref: ${{ github.sha }}
            - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
            - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
              uses: actions/setup-node@v5
              with:
                  node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
                  cache: pnpm
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
            - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
              with:
                  go-version: '1.26.10'
                  cache-dependency-path: native/huhubot/go.sum
            - run: pnpm run check:huhu-bot
            - run: pnpm run build:huhu-bot
            - name: Exercise the native Bot Runner
              shell: bash
              run: |
                  if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "Windows" ]; then
                    node scripts/verify-huhu-bot.mjs native/huhubot/dist/huhu-bot-win32-x64.exe
                  else
                    node scripts/verify-huhu-bot.mjs native/huhubot/dist/huhu-bot-linux-x64
                  fi
            - run: pnpm run build
            - run: pnpm run check:bundle
            - run: git diff --exit-code -- main.js styles.css
            - run: pnpm run lint
            - run: pnpm run lint:css
            - run: pnpm run test:all
            - run: pnpm run check:notices
            - run: pnpm run check:native
